chapter_title_en: Raising the Insects — The Gold Devourer Beetle Problem
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 398: Han Li's Insect Economics
chapter_meta_description: Han Li runs a brutal cost-benefit analysis on the legendary Gold Devourer Beetles, cancels the project, and instead builds over two hundred puppets for his next demon-hunting expedition.
og_title: The Gold Devourer Beetle Problem: Han Li Cancels a Legendary Asset
og_description: In the mortal stream, even a top-tier insect swarm is not worth the investment. Han Li shelves the beetles and spends two years building an army of puppets.
twitter_title: If your ultimate insect can't pay its own feed bill, you cut it from the budget.
twitter_description: Han Li's signature move: treat legendary assets like capital investments, not plot coupons.

lore_anchors.definition: Strange insects ranked near the top of the Strange Insect List; their individual power is limited, but they become devastating when swarming in tens of thousands.
A xianxia bestiary ranking compiled by ancient insect-obsessed cultivators; many top-ranked insects are extinct in the modern era.
An ancient elixir that promotes rank advancement in demon beasts and strange insects; its effect scales poorly across large numbers of individuals.
A rare strange insect that is the natural predator of the Gold Devourer Beetle; Han Li’s pair respond dramatically to the Spirit Nourishing Pill.
A magic treasure that Qu Hun has partially refined, able to be stored in the body and unleash about 70% of its power.
A cultivation method requiring enormous quantities of demon beast inner cores for its revolutions; Han Li is preparing for the second revolution.
A dark artifact containing the lingering, consciousness-less souls of the dead, used by Han Li as disposable material for puppet refinement.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li give up on the Gold Devourer Beetles so quickly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He calculates that even with the Heaven Vial, he cannot raise a functionally powerful swarm (tens of thousands) within a century, so he cuts his losses and shifts resources to assets with faster returns.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Spirit Nourishing Pill's main use here?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It works brilliantly on the Bloodjade Spiders, pushing them to top-grade first-tier, but its effect on the beetles is negligible because the pill is diluted across hundreds of individuals.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li spend two years making puppets instead of training?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He needs a combat-ready force for his upcoming deep-sea demon hunting expedition; puppets are a known, controllable asset with no maturing timeline, unlike the beetles.
